name: WF-255 — Seller Offer Package → Offer Dispatch, Delivery Receipt & Negotiation State

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const status=String(d.status??"").toLowerCase();const channel=String(d.channel??d.offer_channel??"").toLowerCase();const offer=d.offer_package??{};const offer_price=Number(offer.offer_price??d.offer_price??NaN),mao=Number(offer.mao_ceiling??d.dynamic_mao??NaN);const recipient=String(d.recipient??d.seller_contact??"").trim();const dispatch_id=d.dispatch_id??`offer:${deal_id??"unknown"}:${offer_price}`;let state="needs_review",reason="Offer dispatch requires review.",next="WF-126";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){state="blocked";reason="Missing lead, deal, or property identity.";}else if(status!=="offer_package_ready"){state="package_not_ready";reason="Seller offer package is not ready.";next="WF-254";}else if(!["sms","email"].includes(channel)){state="channel_required";reason="A supported seller communication channel is required.";next="WF-254";}else if(!recipient){state="recipient_missing";reason="Seller recipient is required.";next="WF-254";}else if(!Number.isFinite(offer_price)||!Number.isFinite(mao)||offer_price<=0||offer_price>mao){state="maO_guardrail_failed";reason="Offer price is invalid or exceeds dynamic MAO.";next="WF-254";}else{state="dispatch_ready";reason="Offer dispatch is authorized for controlled outbound execution.";next="WF-256";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-255",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,channel,recipient,offer_price,mao_ceiling:mao,dispatch_id,idempotency_key:`wf255:${dispatch_id}`,dispatch_state:state,reason,requires_human_review:true,next_workflow:next,delivery_receipt_required:true,provider_execution:"external_provider_required"}}];
